steps.caption: Counts of every record type: companies, people, buildings, spaces, requirements…
…opportunities, leases, interactions, source files and imports in progress. Click one to open its list.
Needs review lists import rows waiting for a decision.
Recent changes: who changed what — the full audit log is one click away.
Now places: open Places in the More menu.
Places nest: city › corridor › micro-market › locality.
Pune is the city; East corridor holds the SBD East micro-market and its localities.
Each place keeps other spellings, so 'KP' or 'Vimannagar' still match.
Search a place by any of its names.
Add place (at the bottom) creates a new one with its level, parent and other names.
